name: Greystead Bamburgh
accommodation: Four-bedroom house sleeping 10, with children's playroom
dogs: Listed as pet friendly by Visit Northumberland; check with owner
beachAccess: A short walk from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Sitting room, games room, playroom, large dining kitchen, enclosed garden, Wi-Fi, laundry, free entry to Seafield Ocean Club
overview: A large holiday house on Front Street in the centre of Bamburgh, overlooking the cricket pitch and a short walk from the castle and beach. It sleeps 10 across four bedrooms, with a games room, playroom and enclosed garden. Guests also get free entry to the pool and spa at the Seafield Ocean Club.
surfTripFit: Room for a big group, parking for several cars and a short walk to the beach make it a strong group surf-trip base.
